decisions.reason: Ending further revision work and removing the review protocol does not alter the established Hero V and É accent peak-alignment rule.
The source ends the project but does not revise or cancel the selected champagne-gold finish or its distribution in the current artwork.
The source ends future design revisions but does not change the accepted proof-file formats or impose a new format requirement for the requested working-file handoff.
The project termination does not change the established common-baseline rule; the reported hierarchy and geometry failure is not a client modification of that rule.
